ozempic.name: Ozempic (injection)
uses: Blood sugar control in adults with type 2 diabetes
Lower risk of major cardiovascular events in adults with type 2 diabetes and heart disease
Reduce risk of kidney disease progression in adults with type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease
ozempic.us: FDA-approved (type 2 diabetes). Not approved for weight loss — Wegovy is the semaglutide brand for that.
ozempic.ca: Approved in Canada. Health Canada has also authorized generic semaglutide injections for type 2 diabetes (Dr. Reddy's, April 28, 2026; Apotex, May 1, 2026).
ozempic.boxed: Boxed warning: risk of thyroid C-cell tumors. Do not use if you or a family member has had medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or if you have Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).
ozempic.cost: US self-pay through NovoCare and partner pharmacies has been about $349/month for most doses (higher for 2 mg). With commercial insurance, savings cards can lower copays. Verify current prices before you fill.

ozempic-tablets.name: Ozempic tablets (formerly Rybelsus)
uses: Blood sugar control in adults with type 2 diabetes
Lower risk of major cardiovascular events in adults with type 2 diabetes at high risk
ozempic-tablets.us: FDA approved the Ozempic name for oral semaglutide 1.5 mg, 4 mg and 9 mg tablets on February 4, 2026; US launch May 4, 2026. Rybelsus 3/7/14 mg remains available during the transition. A 25 mg tablet is under FDA review.
ozempic-tablets.ca: Rybelsus is approved in Canada; check the Health Canada Drug Product Database for the current brand name.
top: 9 mg once daily after at least 30 days (Rybelsus: 14 mg)
ozempic-tablets.boxed: Boxed warning: risk of thyroid C-cell tumors. Do not use if you or a family member has had medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or if you have Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).
ozempic-tablets.cost: Brand-only in the US. Check NovoCare and manufacturer savings programs.

wegovy.name: Wegovy (injection)
uses: Weight reduction and long-term maintenance in adults and children 12+ with obesity, or adults with overweight and a weight-related condition
Reduce major cardiovascular events in adults with heart disease and obesity or overweight
MASH (fatty liver disease) with moderate-to-advanced fibrosis in adults
wegovy.us: FDA-approved. A higher 7.2 mg dose, Wegovy HD, was approved March 19, 2026.
wegovy.ca: Approved in Canada. Health Canada authorized the first generic semaglutide for weight management on June 29, 2026.
top: 7.2 mg weekly for adults who have tolerated 2.4 mg for at least 4 weeks
wegovy.boxed: Boxed warning: risk of thyroid C-cell tumors. Do not use if you or a family member has had medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or if you have Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).
wegovy.cost: US self-pay through NovoCare and partners has been about $349/month for 0.25–2.4 mg, with intro offers on starter doses; Wegovy HD self-pay was listed around $399/month. Verify before filling.

wegovy-pill.name: Wegovy pill
uses: Weight reduction and long-term maintenance in adults with obesity, or overweight with a weight-related condition (see the label for any additional indications)
wegovy-pill.us: FDA-approved December 22, 2025 — the first oral GLP-1 for weight loss. US launch January 2026.
wegovy-pill.ca: Check the Health Canada Drug Product Database for current status. The European Commission approved it EU-wide in July 2026.
wegovy-pill.boxed: Boxed warning: risk of thyroid C-cell tumors. Do not use if you or a family member has had medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or if you have Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).
wegovy-pill.cost: US self-pay through NovoCare started at $149/month for starter doses; higher doses about $299/month. Promotional prices change — verify before filling.

mounjaro.name: Mounjaro
uses: Blood sugar control in adults with type 2 diabetes
mounjaro.us: FDA-approved for type 2 diabetes. Not approved for weight loss in the US — Zepbound is the tirzepatide brand for that.
mounjaro.ca: Approved in Canada; check the Drug Product Database for current indications.
mounjaro.boxed: Boxed warning: risk of thyroid C-cell tumors. Do not use if you or a family member has had medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or if you have Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).
mounjaro.cost: LillyDirect self-pay pricing has mirrored Zepbound (from about $299/month for 2.5 mg). Verify before filling.

zepbound.name: Zepbound
zepbound.form: Prefilled pen or single-dose vial, subcutaneous injection
uses: Weight reduction and long-term maintenance in adults with obesity, or overweight with a weight-related condition
Moderate-to-severe obstructive sleep apnea in adults with obesity
zepbound.ca: The Zepbound name is US-specific; in Canada tirzepatide is marketed as Mounjaro. Check the Drug Product Database.
zepbound.boxed: Boxed warning: risk of thyroid C-cell tumors. Do not use if you or a family member has had medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or if you have Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).
zepbound.cost: LillyDirect self-pay vials have been about $299/month (2.5 mg), $399 (5 mg) and $449 (higher doses). Verify before filling.

foundayo.name: Foundayo
uses: Weight reduction and long-term maintenance in adults with obesity, or overweight with at least one weight-related condition
foundayo.us: FDA-approved April 1, 2026. Not approved for type 2 diabetes in the US (Lilly has filed in many countries).
foundayo.ca: Check the Health Canada Drug Product Database for current status.
top: 17.2 mg daily (9 mg with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors)
foundayo.boxed: Boxed warning: risk of thyroid C-cell tumors. Do not use if you or a family member has had medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or if you have Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).
foundayo.cost: LillyDirect self-pay launched at $149/month (0.8 mg), $199 (2.5 mg) and $299 (higher doses). With commercial coverage, a savings card may bring it to $25/month. Verify before filling.

victoza.name: Victoza (and generic liraglutide)
uses: Blood sugar control in adults and children 10+ with type 2 diabetes
Lower cardiovascular risk in adults with type 2 diabetes and heart disease
victoza.us: FDA-approved; generic liraglutide (Victoza equivalent) is available.
victoza.boxed: Boxed warning: risk of thyroid C-cell tumors. Do not use if you or a family member has had medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or if you have Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).
victoza.cost: Generic liraglutide is typically far cheaper than branded weekly GLP-1s. Check discount programs.

saxenda.name: Saxenda (and generic liraglutide 3 mg)
uses: Weight management in adults and adolescents 12+ with obesity (adults also with overweight plus a weight-related condition)
saxenda.us: FDA-approved. Teva launched the first generic of Saxenda in August 2025.
saxenda.boxed: Boxed warning: risk of thyroid C-cell tumors. Do not use if you or a family member has had medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or if you have Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).
saxenda.cost: Generic availability has lowered costs; compare pharmacy discount prices.

trulicity.name: Trulicity
uses: Blood sugar control in adults and children 10+ with type 2 diabetes
Lower cardiovascular risk in adults with type 2 diabetes
trulicity.boxed: Boxed warning: risk of thyroid C-cell tumors. Do not use if you or a family member has had medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or if you have Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).
trulicity.cost: Lilly has offered Trulicity through LillyDirect at discounts off list price. Verify current pricing.

byetta-bydureon.name: Byetta and Bydureon BCise
byetta-bydureon.freq: Twice daily (Byetta) or once weekly (Bydureon BCise)
uses: Blood sugar control in type 2 diabetes
byetta-bydureon.us: Largely withdrawn from the US market; availability is limited. Ask a pharmacist before relying on supply.
byetta-bydureon.ca: Check the Drug Product Database for current marketing status.
byetta-bydureon.boxed: Bydureon BCise carries the thyroid C-cell tumor boxed warning; twice-daily Byetta does not.

soliqua.name: Soliqua 100/33
soliqua.cls: Basal insulin + GLP-1 receptor agonist combination
uses: Blood sugar control in adults with type 2 diabetes
soliqua.us: FDA-approved. Standalone lixisenatide (Adlyxin) has been discontinued; lixisenatide remains available inside Soliqua.
top: Set in units by your prescriber based on prior therapy and blood sugar; injected within the hour before the first meal of the day

xultophy.name: Xultophy 100/3.6
xultophy.cls: Basal insulin + GLP-1 receptor agonist combination
uses: Blood sugar control in adults with type 2 diabetes
top: Set in units by your prescriber; injected at the same time each day
xultophy.boxed: Boxed warning: risk of thyroid C-cell tumors. Do not use if you or a family member has had medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or if you have Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).

insulin-lispro.name: Insulin lispro: Humalog, Admelog, Lyumjev
uses: Mealtime blood sugar control in type 1 and type 2 diabetes
insulin-lispro.us: FDA-approved; lower-cost unbranded lispro is available.
top: Humalog/Admelog: within 15 minutes before or right after a meal. Lyumjev: at the start of a meal or within 20 minutes after starting
insulin-lispro.cost: US insulin out-of-pocket costs are capped at $35/month for Medicare; manufacturers offer $35 programs for many patients. Verify eligibility.

insulin-aspart.name: Insulin aspart: NovoLog, Fiasp
uses: Mealtime blood sugar control in type 1 and type 2 diabetes
insulin-aspart.us: FDA-approved; unbranded insulin aspart is available.
top: NovoLog: 5–10 minutes before a meal. Fiasp: at the start of a meal or within 20 minutes after starting
insulin-aspart.cost: See $35 insulin programs and Medicare caps.

insulin-glulisine.name: Insulin glulisine: Apidra
uses: Mealtime blood sugar control in type 1 and type 2 diabetes
top: Within 15 minutes before or within 20 minutes after starting a meal

regular-insulin.name: Regular (short-acting) insulin: Humulin R, Novolin R
uses: Blood sugar control in diabetes
regular-insulin.us: FDA-approved. U-100 is sold over the counter at many US pharmacies; Humulin R U-500 requires a prescription.
regular-insulin.cost: Among the lowest-cost insulins in the US.

nph-insulin.name: NPH (intermediate-acting) insulin: Humulin N, Novolin N
uses: Basal blood sugar control in diabetes
nph-insulin.us: FDA-approved; available over the counter at many US pharmacies.

insulin-glargine.name: Insulin glargine: Lantus, Basaglar, Semglee, Rezvoglar, Toujeo
uses: Basal blood sugar control in type 1 and type 2 diabetes
insulin-glargine.us: FDA-approved. Semglee and Rezvoglar are interchangeable biosimilars to Lantus. Toujeo is a concentrated U-300 form. Levemir (insulin detemir) has been discontinued in the US.
top: U-300 concentration — not unit-for-unit identical to U-100 glargine when switching

insulin-degludec.name: Insulin degludec: Tresiba
uses: Basal blood sugar control in diabetes (adults and children 1+)
insulin-degludec.us: FDA-approved; unbranded insulin degludec is available.
top: Individualized in units; flexible timing, at least 8 hours between doses

insulin-icodec.name: Insulin icodec: Awiqli (once-weekly insulin)
uses: Blood sugar control in adults with type 2 diabetes
insulin-icodec.us: FDA-approved March 26, 2026 — the first once-weekly basal insulin in the US; launched in 2026. Not approved for type 1 diabetes.
insulin-icodec.ca: Approved in Canada and the EU earlier than in the US.
top: Individualized in units by your prescriber; same day each week. Switching from daily insulin follows label-specific instructions
insulin-icodec.cost: Pricing and coverage were still settling at launch; check your plan.

premixed-insulin.name: Premixed insulins: Humalog Mix, NovoLog Mix, Humulin/Novolin 70/30
uses: Blood sugar control in diabetes when a fixed mix suits the routine
premixed-insulin.cost: Human-insulin 70/30 is among the cheapest options.

symlin.name: Symlin
uses: Added to mealtime insulin in type 1 or type 2 diabetes
symlin.ca: Not marketed in Canada as far as public listings show; check the Drug Product Database.
top: Titrated in micrograms by your prescriber; mealtime insulin is usually reduced at the start
symlin.boxed: Boxed warning: severe low blood sugar with insulin, especially in type 1 diabetes.

glucagon.name: Glucagon rescue: GlucaGen, Gvoke, Baqsimi
glucagon.cls: Emergency treatment for severe low blood sugar
glucagon.form: Injection kit, prefilled pen/syringe, nasal powder (Baqsimi)
uses: Severe hypoglycemia in people with diabetes
top: Follow the product's emergency instructions; call emergency services after use
glucagon.cost: Generic and brand options; insurance usually covers rescue glucagon.

cagrisema.name: CagriSema (investigational)
cagrisema.cls: Amylin analog + GLP-1 receptor agonist combination
uses: Under FDA review for chronic weight management
cagrisema.us: Not FDA-approved. Filed December 18, 2025; Novo Nordisk guides to an FDA decision in Q4 2026.

retatrutide.name: Retatrutide (investigational)
retatrutide.cls: GIP / GLP-1 / glucagon triple receptor agonist
uses: In phase 3 trials for obesity, knee osteoarthritis pain and sleep apnea
retatrutide.us: Not FDA-approved. Lilly plans to submit to the FDA in Q1 2027 after positive TRIUMPH-2 and TRIUMPH-3 results (July 2026).
